summary: The ForCES architecture separates control from packet forwarding. This standards-track RFC applies the same modeling approach to management of the Forwarding Element itself, by defining a Logical Functional Block that represents the Forwarding Element Manager. It lets resources beyond plain packet forwarding be managed in the same way.

eli5.summary: A big machine has a part that does the work and a part that manages it. This describes a way to treat the manager as just another piece you can control with the same tools.
